answer: A lantern-lit market of favors exposes a sybil farm. Each identity earns violet trust credits only by completing verified tasks for strangers, and credits rot like velvet in the sun, expiring each epoch. A puppeteer minting a hundred shells must staff a hundred favor queues at full human cost per credit, while an honest agent earns standing once by helping once. Hoarded credits decay, self-dealt favors between kin accounts count for zero, and a proven ring of mutual back-scratching burns its whole stake. Forging a hundred identities means doing a hundred strangers' worth of work, every epoch.
